parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: ConnectType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:

*   slb
*   eni

parameters.name: MseVersion
parameters.description:
The edition of the MSE instance that you want to purchase.

*   mse_pro: Professional Edition
*   mse_dev: Developer Edition

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse query-cluster-specification --connect-type slb --mse-version mse_pro --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse QueryClusterSpecification --region cn-hangzhou --MseVersion mse_pro --AcceptLanguage zh --ConnectType slb
